5\. Concurrent saves can weaken file modes 🐞 Bug ⛨ Security 
_file_mode temporarily sets the process-wide umask to zero and restores it in a separate call. If
this store is used concurrently within one process, another thread can create an overly permissive
file during that interval, and overlapping saves can leave the process's umask at zero.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Reading the current umask by changing it creates a process-wide permissions race. ## Fix Focus Areas - todo/store.py[59-66] - todo/store.py[74-85] ## Recommended Fix Do not call os.umask to calculate a new file's mode. Create the new staging file with an exclusive open requesting mode 0666, allowing the operating system to apply the current umask atomically; apply the existing target's mode separately when replacing a file. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
